technical-summary: Session owner control socket fails closed: the run directory is created 0700 and refused when not owned by the current uid or open to group/world; the socket is bound under a 0177 umask and verified by lstat (socket, owned, mode 0600, never a symlink) before listen; a leftover non-socket, symlink or wrong-mode path at session.sock is refused instead of removed; every accepted connection is checked with SO_PEERCRED (owner uid or root); session.lock is 0600 with O_NOFOLLOW. Unchecked chmod removed.
user-summary-candidate: The serving session's stop/status control socket now refuses unsafe permissions and connections from other users.
